author: Home Repair Tutor
description: I’m cutting this Schluter VARIO drain channel to a custom size. This needs to align with the shower drain and be 1/16” from the wall. I embed this on the shower tray using thin-set mortar and make my tile shower floor slightly higher than it. Many thanks to Schluter for sponsoring this tutorial 🔥
title: Schluter VARIO Drain Channel Cutting Tips - #shorts #schlutersystems #showerremodel #sponsored
